title: Spikers' Turf: Guerra steers VNS-Laticrete past 3B
summary: Howard Guerra led VNS-Laticrete to its second consecutive victory with a 26-24, 25-13, 25-27, 25-17 triumph over 3B in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Open Conference on Wednesday at the Filoil EcoOil Centre.
